title: Exported properties on tool scripts aren't added or removed from the inspector until node is re-selected
body:
### Tested versions

Broken:
v4.6.rc2.official [78c6632eb]
v4.5.1.stable.official [f62fdbde1]
v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]
v4.3.stable.official [77dcf97d8]
v4.2.stable.official [46dc27791]
v4.0.stable.official [92bee43ad]


### System information

Godot v4.6.rc2 - Windows 11 (build 26200)

### Issue description

When you have a `@tool` script, adding `@export` variables will not make them immediately show up on the inspector, unlike if you done so on a non `@tool` script. They only show up once the script is saved and the node is re-selected, and additionally they show the spinner that resets the node to the default value (even though the property IS the default value).

When the script isn't `@tool` the added properties appear immediately and can be edited before saving and re-selecting the node.

I also tested this on v3.6.stable.official [de2f0f147]. In there, the exported properties appear immediately after saving the script without having to re-select the node, and it doesn't add the reset to default value spinner. So if adding the properties immediately isn't possible, bringing this back could be good enough.

### Steps to reproduce

Demonstration:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/362ee66f-c206-4e73-b3b7-a1407456ade2

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

The bug applies to any script with a tool script attached to it so a MRP isn't needed.
